files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Cuda.CudaDiagnostics
files.Summary: Process-wide extension diagnostics; metrics do not control lifetime or admission.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Cuda.CudaErrorDomain
files.Summary: Origin of an extension native failure; NativeCode retains that domain's code.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Cuda.CudaException
files.Summary: A CUDA extension native failure. Consumer execution exceptions are propagated unchanged.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Cuda.CudaImageFrame
files.Summary: Constructs owned GPU frames with display surfaces and original-pixel access.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Cuda.CudaMemoryKind
files.Summary: Scratch storage required by an operation.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Cuda.CudaQueryMetrics
files.Summary: Extension query counters; scratch allocation/reuse and quarantined bytes belong to the bridge.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Cuda.ICudaExecutionScope
files.Summary: A synchronous, thread-affine borrowed CUDA operation. Handles and scratch never escape it.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Cuda.ICudaFrameSource
files.Summary: An independently retained, immutable CUDA image and its executable read access.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Cuda.ICudaResource
files.Summary: An external resource whose cleanup is owned by a bridge after registration.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Drawing.CircleElement
files.Summary: Circle drawing anchored in image coordinates. Radius and stroke units follow ScaleMode.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Drawing.CrosshairElement
files.Summary: Crosshair with a center ring, anchored in image coordinates. Defaults to a fixed screen size.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Drawing.DrawingClickedEventArgs
files.Summary: Identifies the whole drawing that was hit; no individual element index is reported.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Drawing.DrawingElement
files.Summary: Immutable image-coordinate drawing data. Brushes are snapshotted when submitted.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Drawing.DrawingHandle
files.Summary: Owns one drawing containing zero or more elements. Replacement preserves its visual identity and stacking order.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Drawing.DrawingLayer
files.Summary: A layer of image-coordinate drawings. All public operations marshal to the viewer thread.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Drawing.IViewerDrawing
files.Summary: Management and convenience drawing in the default marker layer.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Drawing.LineElement
files.Summary: Line drawing in image coordinates; supports ScaleWithImage and FixedStroke.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Drawing.OverlayScaleMode
files.Summary: How drawing dimensions respond to image zoom; positions remain anchored in image coordinates.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Drawing.RectangleElement
files.Summary: Rectangle drawing in image coordinates; supports ScaleWithImage and FixedStroke.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Drawing.TextElement
files.Summary: Text anchored in image coordinates; supports ScaleWithImage and FixedSize, defaulting to FixedSize.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.ChannelStatistics
files.Summary: Statistics of finite original values for one semantic channel.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.CpuFramePixelReader
files.Summary: Synchronous access to CPU-backed original pixels. Use FrameLease asynchronous read methods for backend-independent access.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.D3D9ImageFrame
files.Summary: Creates owned frames from ready, immutable D3D9 display surfaces.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.FrameDescriptor
files.Summary: Layout of a top-down, single-plane image. Construction stores values; frame factories validate them.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.FrameInfo
files.Summary: Pixel description and viewer-local submission identity. FrameId zero denotes unsubmitted pixels.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.FrameLease
files.Summary: A single ownership token. Do not dispose concurrently with reading its memory.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.FramePixelFormat
files.Summary: Original pixel storage layout; multibyte grayscale values use little-endian byte order.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.FramePixelFormats
files.Summary: Storage-size helpers for supported frame pixel formats.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.FrameSubmissionOptions
files.Summary: Optional source metadata and notification for one frame submission.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.FrameSubmitResult
files.Summary: The actual commit/drop outcome and any processing or submission-owned cleanup failure.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.FrameSubmitStatus
files.Summary: Terminal submission outcome. Inspect FrameSubmitResult.Error separately for processing or cleanup failures.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.ICommittedFrameSource
files.Summary: Access to committed original frames and commit notifications.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.IFramePixelSource
files.Summary: All operations read original pixels. No operation may silently materialize the full image. ReadPixelsAsync transfers its returned sample array; the provider must not reuse or mutate it. Statistics are immutable snapshots and region reads transfer an independently owned image.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.IFrameSink
files.Summary: Frame submission with immediate ownership transfer, including cancellation, rejection and failure.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.ImageFrame
files.Summary: Owned, immutable pixel storage. Do not mutate or release transferred storage.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.PixelCoordinate
files.Summary: Zero-based integer pixel index, not a continuous image position.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.PixelRegion
files.Summary: Integer image region with exclusive right and bottom edges.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.PixelSample
files.Summary: Original pixel values in semantic channel order, without display mapping or unpremultiplication.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.PixelSamplesResult
files.Summary: Ordered original-pixel samples returned by FrameLease.ReadPixelsAsync, with source frame provenance. Construction copies the supplied samples; retain the requested coordinates separately when their association is needed.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.RegionPixels
files.Summary: Owns independently read CPU pixels and their source provenance. Created by after validating the provider result.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.RegionStatistics
files.Summary: Immutable statistics snapshot. Construction copies the supplied channels.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Frames.RegionStatisticsResult
files.Summary: Immutable region statistics with source provenance.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Hud.AnchorAlignment
files.Summary: The anchor alignment within a HUD text element.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Hud.HudTextHandle
files.Summary: Handle for one viewer-owned screen-space text item. Updates and removal dispatch to the viewer STA.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Hud.IViewerHud
files.Summary: Screen-space text and pixel inspection. Operations dispatch to the viewer STA.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.IViewer
files.Summary: Complete viewer capabilities and ownership of asynchronous shutdown.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.IViewerWindow
files.Summary: Borrowed window control. Operations dispatch to the viewer STA and reject calls once shutdown starts.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Imaging.GrayDisplayRange
files.Summary: Grayscale display mapping in original-value units; values outside the bounds are clipped to black or white.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Imaging.IViewerQueries
files.Summary: Shared pixel-query configuration and metrics for measurements and pixel inspection.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Imaging.PixelQueryMetrics
files.Summary: A snapshot of shared query execution and publication-age counters.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Imaging.PixelQueryOptions
files.Summary: Shared query limits. Rates must produce an interval of at least one TimeSpan tick and less than TimeSpan.MaxValue; invalid settings are rejected when applied.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Layers.ViewerLayer
files.Summary: Shared visibility, input and lifetime of a business layer. Operations dispatch to the viewer STA.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Layers.ViewerLayers
files.Summary: Public layer capabilities and default layer composition.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.CircleMeasurementGeometry
files.Summary: Circle with a finite, nonnegative radius in source-image pixels.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.CrosshairMeasurementGeometry
files.Summary: Crosshair location in source-image pixels; marker size is not part of its geometry.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.IMeasurement
files.Summary: A viewer-owned measurement handle. Operations dispatch synchronously to the viewer STA; callbacks run on that STA. Dispose is idempotent and safe after viewer closure. Id, Origin and IsDisposed remain readable after closure; other access requires a running viewer.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.IMeasurementTool
files.Summary: Reusable tool registration. Each activation creates an independent session on the viewer STA.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.IMeasurementToolContext
files.Summary: Capabilities borrowed by custom tools on the viewer STA. Tool callbacks and creation operations must run on that STA; returned measurement handles dispatch themselves. Each factory receives a context for one activation and passes it to its session. Ended contexts reject new measurements.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.IMeasurementToolSession
files.Summary: One activation of a measurement tool. Callbacks run on the viewer STA. Dispose is called exactly once after completion, interruption or callback failure. Cancellation notification is separate from unconditional session-resource cleanup.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.IViewerMeasurements
files.Summary: Measurement tools, interaction, style and notifications on the viewer STA.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.LineMeasurementGeometry
files.Summary: Ordered line endpoints in source-image pixels.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.MeasurementClickResult
files.Summary: Whether a tool click keeps its activation accepting input.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.MeasurementEventArgs
files.Summary: Immutable geometry and query snapshots with a live, thread-safe measurement handle.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.MeasurementGeometry
files.Summary: Closed immutable geometry family in source-image coordinates.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.MeasurementGeometryKind
files.Summary: Shape of a measurement, independent of its originating tool or pixel query.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.MeasurementLayer
files.Summary: Layer for model-owned measurements. Content is created through measurement tools.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.MeasurementOptions
files.Summary: Query and appearance options validated when a measurement is created.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.MeasurementOrigin
files.Summary: Immutable tool registration ID and unique activation ID captured at creation.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.MeasurementQueryKind
files.Summary: Pixel query attached to a compatible measurement geometry.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.MeasurementQueryResult
files.Summary: Common provenance for the closed family of immutable measurement query results.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.MeasurementRegionStatisticsResult
files.Summary: Owned statistics for a nonempty clipped source region.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.MeasurementSampleResult
files.Summary: Owned coordinate/sample pairs for a pixel or ordered line-profile query.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.MeasurementSnapshot
files.Summary: Immutable geometry snapshot of any completed measurement.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.MeasurementStyle
files.Summary: Appearance of newly created measurement shapes. Viewer assignment and shape creation copy and freeze brushes; subsequent changes to the source brushes have no effect.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.MeasurementToolIds
files.Summary: Stable IDs independent of menu labels.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.PointMeasurementGeometry
files.Summary: Point location in source-image pixels; marker size is not part of its geometry.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Measurements.RectangleMeasurementGeometry
files.Summary: Normalized rectangle in source-image pixels.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Menus.CheckableMenuItem
files.Summary: A checkable menu action whose state is evaluated on opening.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Menus.ICheckableMenuItem
files.Summary: A menu item with checked state.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Menus.IMenuItem
files.Summary: Menu callbacks run on the viewer STA. A failure while reading display state cancels that menu opening and is logged; it does not close the viewer.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Menus.IViewerMenu
files.Summary: Registers borrowed menu objects and returns independently revocable registration handles.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Menus.MenuItem
files.Summary: A menu action. Async actions start on the viewer STA and are awaited by the menu binding.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Menus.SeparatorMenuItem
files.Summary: A separator normalized by the menu renderer.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Snapshots.ISnapshotSource
files.Summary: Captures independently owned snapshots of the committed frame or a region. At most two captures are admitted per Viewer, with one export read executing at a time. Further calls throw InvalidOperationException before acquiring a frame lease. Accepted calls capture the committed frame synchronously and may finish after Viewer closure.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Snapshots.ImageSnapshot
files.Summary: Independent immutable pixels. Owns its storage until disposed.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Snapshots.SnapshotEncoding
files.Summary: Snapshot file encoding. Raw snapshots require TIFF; display snapshots support all listed encodings.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Snapshots.SnapshotKind
files.Summary: Pixel representation captured independently of the viewer lifetime.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Viewer
files.Summary:
Displays images, drawings and measurements in an independently owned WPF window.

Creates its WPF window on an independent STA; facade calls marshal to that thread. Borrowed tool contexts retain their own callback-thread restrictions.

files.Title: Fizzy.ImageViewer.Viewport.IViewerDisplay
files.Summary: Image viewport fitting and display mapping, independent of original-pixel queries.
